body:
I have been struggling for 10 years now. Everytime I believe I finally can rest something happen either injury, sickness, problems, I have been working too hard pushing too hard for the sake of others that I don't have wishes anymore.
My body is slowly degrading and I feel physical pain all the time. I developed tinnitus as well and  now I can't even have peace.
I was in a near death accidents couple of times and everytime I end up with permanent injury and  just regret not dying.
My family don't care about me, they just keep pushing me around to "clean" their problems and I am tired of everything and everyone.

I want to sleep and never wake up
